name: GEPRC MARK5
description: 225 mm motor diagonal, 2.5 mm plates, 5 mm arms, 30.5 mm controller and 16 mm motor pitch; approximate outlines.

geometryEvidence.summary: 225 mm motor diagonal, 2.5 mm plates, 5 mm arms, 30.5 mm controller and 16 mm motor pitch; approximate outlines.
geometryEvidence.limitations: Lightweight frame assembly with separate plates, arms, motor pads and spacers. Z is up. The wheelbase is the diameter of the motor-centre circle (opposite motor centres); 4-arm mode permits a squashed-X angle, while 6/8 arms are evenly spaced. Named references preserve only the listed dimensions. Plate outlines, arm roots, clamp joints, spacer locations, hole diameters and unlisted hole coordinates are generic. Only one selected motor pattern and one controller pattern are drilled. No hardware, arm clamps, landing gear, motors, propellers or electronic boards are included. These are layout references, not interchangeable replacement frame parts.
